title: The lab's overlays, on a world where time has stopped
question: Does the overlay now read the same everywhere, instead of only inside the bubble?
context_md:
Your fourth item: *"the overlays from the evolution lab should also work in this game."*

They were already wired in — all three games draw through the same code and nothing skipped them. What broke them was the held-world look: where time is stopped the ground is recoloured to one hue, and that ran *after* the overlay and painted over it. So every channel came out reading as the grey-blue of stopped ground everywhere except inside a bubble — a readout whose answer depended on the thing it was meant to be independent of.

This is the heat channel. The world is one temperature throughout, so the right picture is a flat one.

- **before**: warm only inside the bubble, cold everywhere else — the channel is describing the bubble, not the heat
- **after**: one reading across the whole frame, which is the truth

The bubble's own haze still draws over the top in both, so the game look is not lost — the overlay just wins on the cells it speaks for.

**Still to come from another lane:** there is no key or menu row to turn these on yet. The switches are ready on the renderer and I have said so in my lane note.
